correctness.rationale: A complete 1,278,686-face enumeration from a direct 35-vertex triple representation is certified by the provided executable. Exhaustive directed matching-gradient DAG acyclicity checks for two matchings, on 639,293 and 639,283 pairs respectively, establish valid integral Morse reductions. Signed exact matrices have the composition of consecutive boundary operators zero. Unimodular all-unit Smith reductions (forward ranks 16,11,5; reverse 31,10,1) show primitive images; chain ranks yield exactly degree-six rank 29 and degree-nine rank 7, all other reduced groups zero. Both independent matching orders agree. No homotopy equivalence is inferred.

value.rationale: The exact finite complex is the first positive k=1 case of the triple-subset Kneser independence complexes, a natural topological family with an explicit 2026 family-wide integral torsion question. The original 35-vertex, 1.28-million-simplex model makes direct integer computation substantial. Establishing torsion-freeness for **all** primes in this case is a motivated mathematical advance over previously published rational and mod-two tables, not an arbitrary new parameter or unmotivated numerical fact. It is reusable as a precise base case and computational benchmark, without suggesting the full conjecture is resolved.
